questions.question: What auth model fits how this app will actually be used?

options.label: Single shared login (Recommended)
options.description: One operator password + signed HttpOnly session cookie, enforced by middleware over the dashboard and all /api/* routes (OAuth callbacks + cron-with-secret excepted). Fast, no new infra, closes the CRITICAL hole now. We can upgrade to multi-user later. Best if it's just you (or a small trusted team sharing one login).

options.label: Multi-user accounts
options.description: Full NextAuth with a User model and per-user login. Enables per-user audit trail (who approved/posted a reply â€” addresses the compliance gap) and real team access. Bigger lift, pairs naturally with the Postgres migration, and needs a User/Team data model. Best if multiple people need separate logins.

options.label: Just lock it down minimally
options.description: HTTP Basic auth via middleware using an env username/password â€” the absolute fastest way to stop anonymous access, no login UI. Ugly UX but unblocks a private pilot in minutes. Upgrade later.
